acceptance: Compare the changed experience under the same conditions and check functionality/appearance after optimization. Review cold/warm paths and the primary interaction. Do not claim a device result from emulation without naming that limitation. Avoid broad repeated benchmarks after the actual risk is resolved.

title: Nasadenie a návrat predchádzajúcej verzie
tags: release deployment rollout rollback migration
use: Use when a reviewable change is moving into a shared or production environment. Separate preparing the release from executing external publication.
decision: Confirm the authorized environment, release scope, dependencies and rollback owner. Identify changes that cannot be undone by reverting code, including data migrations and external side effects. Carry forward existing user authorization; do not demand redundant approval for an already authorized action.
deliverable: Provide the live/review URL when available, version, verification, rollback route and material limits. Keep a blocked release distinct from completed local work. Do not claim deployment or persistence from an unexecuted command or a failed push.
acceptance: After an authorized release, check the real deployed primary journey, configuration, errors and meaningful monitoring. Confirm the version actually served. If a critical issue appears, use the authorized rollback route or clearly report the blocked decision. A successful deployment status alone is not functional acceptance.

title: Monitoring a riešenie incidentov
tags: observability logging metrics traces SLO incident
use: Use when the site has ongoing operational responsibility or a failure needs diagnosis. Instrument what helps restore the visitor's task.
decision: Define critical operations and useful indicators: accepted booking rate, checkout errors, latency or content delivery freshness. Distinguish user-visible service health from infrastructure activity. Agree objectives and response ownership appropriate to the actual business, not an arbitrary enterprise number.
deliverable: Provide operational indicators, dashboard/query locations, response owner, runbook and known blind spots. Record observed incident lessons as targeted improvements. Do not promise 24/7 support or availability levels without an agreed service commitment and capacity.
acceptance: Exercise an authorized known failure to confirm visibility and routing. Check whether alerts distinguish a provider outage from a frontend exception. Validate recovery and watch for recurrence under stated conditions. An empty dashboard does not prove the absence of failure if instrumentation is broken.

title: Inžinierstvo a odovzdanie
tags: Inžinierstvo a odovzdanie engineering and handoff
use: Maintainability, security and developer handoff
decision: Separate presentation, domain authority and operating responsibility.
deliverable: Editable sources, contracts and reproducible delivery.
acceptance: Verify actual commands, integrations and the receiving maintainer's needs.

title: SEO a migrácia adries
tags: SEO sitemap canonical redirect migration structured data
use: Use when public content must be discoverable or existing addresses change. Preserve truthful, useful content and technical continuity.
decision: Identify indexable pages, language variants, canonical identity and valuable existing destinations. Separate search discoverability from ranking promises. Decide which old pages have genuine replacements; do not redirect every removed URL to the homepage without considering intent.
deliverable: Provide metadata rules, migration map, executed checks and post-release observation plan. Keep actual traffic/ranking evidence separate from implementation claims. A technically clean migration reduces avoidable disruption but does not guarantee search positions or a growth percentage.
acceptance: Inspect representative direct requests, redirects, status codes and rendered content. Check unexpected chains, loops and wrong destinations. Validate the deployed configuration rather than only local markup. Use current official search guidance for feature-specific requirements.

title: Analytika a experimenty
tags: analytics conversion metrics experiment AB test
use: Use when evaluating business behavior or comparing design alternatives. Define the measurement before interpreting a chart.
decision: Choose the decision, primary metric, denominator, observation window and guardrails. Distinguish link clicks, submissions, accepted bookings and revenue. Check whether the available traffic and data quality can support an experiment; small samples may only justify qualitative learning.
deliverable: Provide metric definitions, data limits, observations and the justified decision. Do not claim uplift from visual polish alone. If evidence is insufficient, recommend the next useful observation rather than manufacturing precision or launching an oversized experiment programme.
acceptance: Check missing/duplicate events, bot/internal traffic assumptions and end-to-end outcome reconciliation where available. Validate assignment persistence and guardrails. Distinguish observational correlation, controlled evidence and subjective preference. Use the relevant analytics skill for consequential analysis.

title: Údržba a zastarávanie
tags: maintenance upgrades deprecation ownership support
use: Use when the site must remain usable after delivery. Maintenance is an ownership and change process, not only dependency updates.
decision: Identify owners for content, integrations, dependencies, infrastructure and credentials. Set a realistic support scope and review cadence based on consequences. Separate urgent vulnerabilities or broken provider contracts from optional cosmetic updates.
deliverable: Provide ownership, maintenance tasks, support boundaries, known deprecations and update evidence. Keep the handoff usable by the actual team. A premium website's value includes the ability to change a price or replace a photograph without rebuilding its core experience.
acceptance: Exercise the affected journey after each material change. Recheck provider connectivity, permission boundaries and rendering compatibility when those dependencies move. Do not imply ongoing background monitoring or scheduled work unless an actual authorized automation/service exists.

title: Technický dlh a refaktoring
tags: refactor legacy technical debt migration cleanup
use: Use when existing structure makes a requested change risky or slow. Improve a concrete constraint rather than rewriting for personal preference.
decision: Identify the cost of the debt: duplicated authority, fragile lifecycle, untestable boundary, obsolete dependency or inconsistent data. Compare a local repair, incremental extraction and replacement. Keep approved behavior and user changes intact.
deliverable: Explain the original constraint, what became easier/safer and the evidence that behavior survived. Record remaining debt with consequences and revisit triggers. Stop when the authorized change is reliable; do not use the task as permission for an unlimited architecture cleanup.
acceptance: Run checks that protect the behavior being preserved and inspect the affected UI. Check performance/resource ownership if the refactor changes lifecycle. Review the diff for unrelated churn and accidental loss of in-progress work. A smaller file count is not by itself an improvement.

title: Tímové kontrakty a code review
tags: team review PR ownership interfaces collaboration
use: Use when several contributors work on the same product or a change needs another maintainer's review. Make boundaries and intent easy to inspect.
decision: Define module ownership, integration contracts and the minimum shared context. Separate parallel independent work from dependent mutations. Delegate only when the session and applicable instructions authorize it; this chapter is not blanket permission to create agents.
deliverable: Provide a reviewable diff, interface decisions, test evidence and unresolved material issues. Keep code and design handoff aligned. Do not send external comments or messages unless explicitly authorized, and do not claim an independent review when everyone saw the intended answer.
acceptance: Inspect the combined behavior at integration seams, not only each contributor's local result. Check that cleanup, naming, error semantics and dependency versions agree. Investigate conflicting findings from the source artifact and run targeted checks rather than averaging opinions.

title: Enterprise riadenie a oddelenie tenantov
tags: enterprise multitenancy governance roles audit SSO
use: Use when the actual programme has multiple organizations, teams or privileged workflows. Do not infer enterprise needs from a large price aspiration alone.
decision: Map tenants, actors, data boundaries, identity systems, audit needs and operating responsibilities. Choose isolation appropriate to risk and scale. Separate brand customization from data authority. A tenant ID in a UI filter is not enforced isolation.
deliverable: Provide the tenancy/permission model, responsibility map, compatibility plan, targeted evidence and material gaps. Make the first useful release explicit. Avoid presenting a marketing frontend with an admin login as a complete enterprise platform.
acceptance: Use authorized fixtures for two tenants and several roles. Test direct resource IDs, cached reads, exports, background events and revoked access. Exercise migration/rollout compatibility across consumers. Verify the actual server boundary; visual separation and login alone cannot prove isolation.

title: Náklady, kapacita a efektívnosť
tags: cost capacity hosting bandwidth GPU budget sustainability
use: Use when traffic, media or integrations create ongoing costs. Connect estimates to actual usage assumptions.
decision: Identify cost drivers: bandwidth, media transformations, database/query load, storage, third-party operations and support. Distinguish average usage from bursts. Use current provider pricing only after verification and label estimates clearly.
deliverable: Provide assumptions, scenario estimates, current source dates, cost ownership and warning thresholds. Do not turn a small site into a distributed platform solely to appear scalable. A predictable bill and understandable operating model are part of professional developer value.
acceptance: Compare estimates with actual observed usage where available. Check whether omitted egress, retries, backups or provider minimums materially change the result. Use authorized load tests only within the permitted environment and scale; do not stress live third parties without permission.

title: Produkčný rozsah a dodávatelia
tags: procurement scope media vendor license deliverables
use: Use when photographs, video, 3D, copy, licenses or specialist implementation must be sourced. Make deliverables inspectable before committing resources.
decision: Define whether the need is a finished asset, editable source, ongoing service or technical integration. Compare supplied material, commissioned production and generated illustration against truth, quality, cost, rights and future editing. Do not purchase or sign anything without authorization.
deliverable: Provide the production brief, selected option rationale, source/derivative inventory and acceptance findings. Record unresolved dependencies and who owns revisions. Do not treat a payment or a long prompt as evidence that the result meets the website's actual needs.
acceptance: Inspect delivered assets in the intended composition, not only a supplier preview. Check editable structure, exports, color/format correctness, license scope and compatibility with the runtime budget. Test a representative derivative before accepting a large batch.

title: Praktické učenie a zlepšovanie
tags: Praktické učenie a zlepšovanie benchmark and learning
use: Task applications and observed lessons
decision: Improve the skill from demonstrated failures without contaminating evaluation.
deliverable: A bounded reusable correction and honest evidence.
acceptance: Use raw artifacts and distinguish task applications from statistical quality proof.

title: Záverečná seniorská kontrola
tags: senior final review acceptance delivery done
use: Use before declaring an authorized task complete. Review the outcome against its actual scope rather than performing every possible check.
decision: Identify the user-visible result, critical invariants and relevant acceptance evidence. For a small edit inspect the affected path; for a full release review the complete primary journey and material boundaries. Treat visual quality, functionality, truth and operability as separate requirements.
deliverable: Lead with what is complete, explain the key decision briefly, state verification and remaining material limits. Give the actual review/live artifact where appropriate. Never promise universal senior expertise, guaranteed price, a measured quality multiplier or hidden ongoing learning from the existence of this skill.
acceptance: Run only the remaining checks needed to resolve concrete risks. Confirm the main task still works after final corrections. For publication, inspect the authorized deployed version when accessible. Stop optional polishing once scope and meaningful evidence are sufficient; do not substitute more chapters, tools or tests for a working result.
